notes: Structube (Magento PWA Studio SPA, structube.com). Access: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (generic 'User-agent: *' Magento boilerplate); /graphql is disallowed for crawlers generally but not Claude-specifically, and was used as the side-door per project convention (matches this company's prior Home-Decor pass). Discovery: (1) full site nav bar (rendered via Playwright) = Furniture, Decor, Mattresses, New, Open Box, Sale, Small Budget, Top Value, Premium, Inspiration -- no Bestsellers/Popular/Trending/Top Sellers item anywhere. (2) Full GraphQL category tree from root id 2 (all ~40 category nodes, 3 levels deep) inspected by name -- no node named/resembling Bestsellers, Best Sellers, Top Sellers, Most Popular, Customer Favorites, or Trending. Nodes that could be confused for it -- 'Top Value' (id 749, meaning best-value/price-tier, French 'meilleure-valeur'), 'Premium' (id 771), 'Commercial Quality' (id 813) -- are price/quality tiers, not popularity-based merchandising. (3) Both EN and FR sitemaps (media/sitemap_en_ca.xml, media/sitemap_fr_ca.xml, 3454 URLs each) grepped for bestsell/best-sell/top-sell/popular/trending/favorite/meilleures-ventes/tendance -- zero PLP matches; the only hit was /inspiration/popular-posts, a blog listing of editorial posts, not a product listing, and 'meilleure-valeur' (Top Value price tier, not bestsellers). No site-search feature was found separate from the main catalog search, and the catalog default sort is 'Best Match' (a relevance sort control, not a Bestsellers PLP). Conclusion: Structube has no genuine Bestsellers-type merchandising PLP in either language. This is a confirmed absence, not a missed search.
